invariants.rationale: Method parameters in Java are non-null unless explicitly allowed, so args should not be null.

meta.value: args is not null at method entry

invariants.rationale: Array length in Java is always non-negative.
If args has length > 0, the first element may be non-null.

meta.value: args[0] may be non-null if array length > 0

invariants.expression: args.length == 0 || args[0] == null || args[0] instanceof String
invariants.rationale: Elements of String[] are either null or instances of String.

meta.value: args elements are Strings or null
